# Cinderpaper

Cinderpaper is a minimalist, Nord-inspired theme with balanced light and dark modes aimed at readability and usability. Accent color, fonts and sizes are adjustable through theme variables.

![Cinderpaper screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adnan0-im/Obisidian_Cinderpaper/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cinderpaper"
    author: "Adnan"
    repo:   "adnan0-im/Obisidian_Cinderpaper"
    slug:   "cinderpaper"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cinderpaper"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/adnan0-im/Obisidian_Cinderpaper"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adnan0-im/Obisidian_Cinderpaper/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a clean, minimalist Nord-inspired Obsidian theme with balanced light and dark modes for improved readability and usability. Customize accent, fonts, and sizes via theme variables to tailor the visual style to your workflow."
}
```
